products.description:
My SmallRig heavy-duty tripod is built for stability and smooth motion, perfect for capturing cinematic shots. It's designed to be both light and strong, capable of supporting up to 8.5 kg without issue. The integrated fluid head ensures super smooth pans and tilts, and it can be extended up to 2 meters high for versatile shooting.

In this kit:
*   SmallRig heavy-duty tripod with fluid head
*   Fluid head handle
*   DJI adapter plate
*   Carrying case

I also offer a 100cm carbon fibre slider as a direct add-on for £10/day. Looking for a camera? I can add a Sony a7III 4K camera for £25/day, a Sony a7S III 4K camera for £40/day, or a Blackmagic Pocket Cinema Camera 6K Pro for £40/day.

Beyond this kit, I have a wide range of other gear available, including Sony and Blackmagic cameras, drones, gimbals, lights, LEDs, wireless mics, image transmitters, follow focus systems, monitors, motorized sliders, mobile power generators, a variety of lenses (including anamorphic), other tripods and stands, smoke machines, and filters (VND, mist, UV).

A quick note on power: chargers are included with the kit. I only supply proprietary charging cables — anything that charges over a standard USB-C or USB 2.0 lead isn't included, so please bring your own. I do my best to have everything charged for pickup, but with tight turnarounds between rentals I can't always promise a full battery; if it's a time-sensitive shoot, collect the day before or leave an hour or two to top up.
